description: Defines the DnsQuery class for constructing, parsing, and managing DNS query messages, including related enums, methods, and data members.

classes.name: DnsQuery
classes.description: Represents an on-the-wire DNS query message, providing methods for construction, parsing, cloning, and access to query fields.

methods.name: DnsQuery
methods.description: Constructor to create a DNS query with specified parameters.

methods.name: DnsQuery
methods.description: Constructor to initialize from a raw packet buffer.

methods.name: CloneWithNewId
methods.description: Creates a copy of the query with a new ID.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses the raw buffer to populate the DNS query fields.

methods.name: qname
methods.description: Returns the query name as a byte span.

methods.name: question
methods.description: Returns the question section as a string piece.

methods.name: question_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the question section.

methods.name: set_flags
methods.description: Sets flags for the DNS query.
